Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: Preparation of pleated RGO/MXene/Fe3O4 microsphere and its absorption properties for electromagnetic wave

Process_Text.original: GOx, MXene and Fe3O4 nanoparticles were added to 20 mL deionized water in a certain proportion. GOx/MXene/Fe3O4 microspheres were prepared by ultrasonic atomizer. The process conditions and washing process were same as that of RGO/MXene microspheres. After dispersing GOx/MXene/Fe3O4 in L-ascorbic acid aqueous solution with concentration of 3.6mg/mL and reducing for 30 min at 90°C, RGO/MXene/Fe3O4 microspheres were obtained by magnetic separation.
Process_Text.simplified: Ultrasonic atomization of precursor droplets into liquid paraffin at 150°C, followed by chemical reduction using L-ascorbic acid at 90°C for 30 min.

Process_Info.Equipment: Ultrasonic atomizer (Beijing Oriental Jin Rong Ultrasonic Electric Appliance Co. Ltd.)

Properties_Info.Test_Condition: Coaxial ring sample with 40wt% loading in paraffin, frequency range 2.0-18.0 GHz

Measured_Composition.Note: Fe3O4 content determined as 37.5% by TGA

Microstructure_Text.simplified: Pleated microsphere morphology with diameter ~6um. Surface wrinkles increase with Fe3O4 content. Fe3O4 nanoparticles (avg 10nm) are encapsulated within the layered RGO/MXene structure.
